structs.name: TransmittedSpecificStaticSpeed
structs.info: Defines a single specific static speed restriction transmitted as part of the Static Speed Profile (SSP). It specifies conditions under which a different static line speed applies to certain train categories or cant deficiency classes.

attrs.name: q_diff
attrs.formatNote: The integer value representing the equivalent binary. As in TSI CCS Subset 26, chapter 7. 7.5.1.102.1
attrs.info: Qualifier for specific SSP categories. In case of 'other specific' SSP, it tells ERTMS/ETCS on-board equipment whether it replaces or not the Cant Deficiency SSP as selected by on-board (ref. 3.11.3.2.3), when the train belongs to an 'other international' train category to which the 'other specific' SSP applies
attrs.label: Q_Diff

attrs.name: nc_cddiff
attrs.info: It is the 'Cant Deficiency' SSP category for which a different value for the static line speed exists. Used together with V_DIFF to permit certain trains to go faster or lower than the 'international basic static speed' given by V_STATIC. Note: nc_cddiff only needed If Q_DIFF(n) = 0
attrs.label: Nc_Cddiff

attrs.name: nc_diff
attrs.info: It is the 'other specific' SSP category for which a different value for the static line speed exists. Used together with V_DIFF to permit trains belonging to the corresponding 'other international' train category to go faster or lower than the 'international basic static speed' given by V_STATIC. Value 0 of NC_DIFF corresponds to the LSB of NC_TRAIN, value 14 of NC_DIFF to MSB (15-bit variable) of NC_TRAIN.
attrs.label: Nc_Diff

attrs.name: v_diff
attrs.formatNote: The value must be a multiple of 5km/h
attrs.info: Absolute Positive Speed associated to a train category. Resolution is 5 km/h
attrs.label: V_Diff
